description: This file defines a React component named FormWizard, implementing a multi-step form with navigation, validation, and review features. It manages form state, validation logic, focus handling, and user interaction for a flexible multi-step wizard interface.

methods.name: getStepErrors
methods.description: Returns validation errors for a specified step without blocking navigation.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Validates email format using a regex.

methods.name: isFormValid
methods.description: Determines the overall validity of the entire form based on step validations and consent.

methods.name: computeS1
methods.description: Checks if Step 1 is valid for visual progress indication.

methods.name: computeS2
methods.description: Checks if Step 2 is valid for visual progress indication.

methods.name: computeS3
methods.description: Checks if Step 3 is valid for visual progress indication.

methods.name: markTyping
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating the user is currently typing, used for UX improvements.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change events and updates form data.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles input focus events and tracks which field is focused.

methods.name: onBlurField
methods.description: Handles blur events for inputs and updates validation error hints.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing a specific section from the review screen.

methods.name: saveFromEdit
methods.description: Saves edits and returns to review mode.

methods.name: setInputRef
methods.description: Assigns refs to input elements for focus management.
